llm.summary: The skill is a scoped Chinese K12 chemistry lesson-planning aid with disclosed class-workspace use and no executable install behavior.

dimensions.detail: The skill is intentionally scoped to simplified-Chinese Mainland China K12 chemistry curricula and emergency-channel assumptions; this is coherent for that deployment but should be localized before use elsewhere.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains Markdown and JSON reference material only; I found no executable scripts, install hooks, remote payload retrieval, or tool-wrapping behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Activation is constrained to chemistry lesson design, with explicit handoffs for lab operations, exams, parent communications, assignments, and other subjects; it also restricts sensitive exam and student personal data handling.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: It uses platform memory/file capabilities for a class teaching workspace, but the read/write fields are scoped, writeback is described as teacher-confirmed lesson-plan entries, and privacy controls for view, correction, deletion, pause, sharing, and export are disclosed.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: Purpose and capabilities align: it creates chemistry lesson-plan drafts, uses curriculum references, and limits lab work to lesson-placement and safety-level screening rather than operational experiment instructions.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Use this skill for Mainland China Chinese K12 chemistry lesson planning. Because it can reference class-level and pseudonymous student learning data, confirm the platform's consent, memory, sharing, and deletion controls are configured; localize curriculum assumptions and emergency contacts before deploying outside that context.
llm.findings:
[AE4] expected: The flagged files are ordinary UTF-8 Chinese curriculum and skill text mixed with ASCII identifiers and chemistry notation; I found no hidden instructions or obfuscation behavior.
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese-only labels and Mainland China locale assumptions are explicit and consistent with the skill's stated Chinese K12 chemistry-teacher purpose, not an undisclosed policy constraint.
[aig-skill-scan] expected: The static scan reported no T01-T09 results, consistent with the inspected artifact containing no executable code, persistence hooks, or remote execution instructions.
